policy: These exact named NPC coordinates are explicitly identified by the Wiki as the instructors at the corresponding canoe station. They locate station access in decoded walking geometry; they are not inferred nearest tiles or canoe landing coordinates.

coordinateEvidence.detail: Barfy Bill explains canoe building in Lumbridge and lends a hatchet; exact NPC map at the station.
Tarquin teaches canoeing at the Champions' Guild; exact NPC map at the station.
Sigurd mans the canoe station east of Gunnarsgrunn; exact NPC map at that station.
Hari stands at the Edgeville canoe station and guides use of the canoe system; exact NPC map.
